_comment: /etc/waf-report/apps.json (640 root:root) — the apps waf-report reports on. One entry per app: its hosts, its session cookie (Str::slug(APP_NAME).'-session' unless SESSION_COOKIE overrides it) and the exclusions file the report points at. Where a report goes is notify's business: name is the app's key in /etc/notify/apps.json, whose channels it is sent to. http3_default: true on the one app that listens on HTTP/3, whose requests reach ModSecurity without a Host.
